title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Total-Loss Surrender Settlement Acceptance: Desk Systems Reference
content:
**Subject.** The surrender settlement is the net settlement a customer accepts under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage when a total-loss vehicle and its title go to Cardinal; a vehicle the customer keeps is settled under the kept-vehicle rules instead.

## When the settlement can be fixed

The surrender settlement is fixed only after the claim carries an accepted coverage decision stating its deductible.

Put the other way round, while the claim file shows no accepted coverage decision with a stated deductible, the claim has no surrender settlement figure.

## Business effect of the customer's acceptance

When the customer accepts the surrender settlement, one accepted settlement is recorded on the claim: the vehicle goes to Cardinal (settlement option surrender to Cardinal), the net settlement figure the customer accepts and the payoff their lender or lessor states are recorded, and the offer and the acceptance are both dated today. The signed title is still to be received, so nothing is paid by the acceptance; the customer sees the settlement as accepted.

## The acceptance tool

**Tool:** `accept_total_loss_settlement_c07cd979`

**Who runs it.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, accepting in person the total-loss settlement of their vehicle and surrendering the vehicle and its title to Cardinal.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_number` | The claim number of the total-loss claim being settled, as the claims desk gives it to the customer before the call | Text identifier |
| `settlement_amount` | The net settlement the customer accepts | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `loss_payee_payoff_amount` | The payoff stated on the lender's or lessor's payoff letter for the vehicle | USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when the vehicle carries no loan or lease |

**Return.** A receipt with `settlement_id` (reference of the accepted settlement), `claim_number`, `settlement_option` (always `surrender_to_cardinal`), `settlement_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places), `loss_payee_payoff_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places), `offer_status` (always `accepted`) and `accepted_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying `settlement_id` means the acceptance is recorded.

## Reference questions

- *Does the acceptance pay the customer?* No. It records the accepted settlement; the signed title is still to be received.
- *What does the payoff figure carry when the vehicle is owned outright?* 0.00.
- *Is a kept vehicle accepted here?* No; this acceptance always records the vehicle as surrendered to Cardinal.
